The Reichstag today adopted the new law for the protection of the republic by a vote of 265 to 150. The law supersedes the old defense law which went out of operation on July 22, 1929. Under the old law the former Kaiser was specifically forbidden to re-enter Germany. The new law does not contain this provision and while under it the Kaiser theoretically would be free to return.
